CasterDef.description:
What a caster casts and how it fights: it casts each spell at its target whenever the spell is ready and the
target is in range and in sight, in the listed order. While it casts it stands still and faces its target; a
target out of range or out of sight sends it after the target until it can cast again.

kiting.description: Its step between two casts; without it, it stands where it cast.

spells.description: Its spells, by id (realmforge:<id>), most important first. Each targets an enemy.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

spells.title: Spells

CasterDef.title: CasterDef

DropCountDef.description: How many of the item one drop gives: a whole number from ``min`` to ``max``, each as likely.
DropCountDef.title: DropCountDef

KitingDef.description:
How a caster moves between two casts (research BM-22): a quick step of ``step_blocks``, away from its target
when it stays in range there, otherwise around the target or a little toward it, so the next cast is in range and
in sight again. The mob AI's reusable kiting (``mob/ai/Kiting``).

speed_percent.description: How fast it steps, in percent of its walking speed: 50 to 300.
speed_percent.title: Speed Percent

step_blocks.description: How far one step goes, in blocks: 1 to 6.
step_blocks.title: Step Blocks

KitingDef.title: KitingDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

attack_interval_seconds.description: The time between two of its hits, in seconds: vanilla's monsters hit every 1 s.
attack_interval_seconds.title: Attack Interval Seconds

knock_up_blocks.description: How high each hit throws its target, in blocks, on top of vanilla's knockback; 0 for none.
knock_up_blocks.title: Knock Up Blocks

MobAttributesDef.description: The mob's vanilla attributes at level 1; its level scales health, armor and damage (architecture 14.1).

attack_damage.description: Damage of a melee hit, in health points.
attack_damage.title: Attack Damage

follow_range.description: How far in blocks it notices a player and follows its target.
follow_range.title: Follow Range

knockback_resistance_percent.description: The share of knockback it shrugs off, 0 to 100.
knockback_resistance_percent.title: Knockback Resistance Percent

movement_speed.description: Vanilla's movement speed: a zombie's is 0.23.
movement_speed.title: Movement Speed

MobAttributesDef.title: MobAttributesDef

MobDropDef.description:
One item the mob may drop when it dies: rolled on its own, so drops never crowd each other out. Every drop is
worth having (the vision: no trash loot). Looting raises it as vanilla's drops: more of the item, a better
chance, or both.

chance_percent.description: The chance it drops at all, in percent: 100 by default.
chance_percent.title: Chance Percent

count.description: How many: from min to max, 1 by default.

looting_chance_percent.description: Each level of Looting adds this much to the chance, in percent points.
looting_chance_percent.title: Looting Chance Percent

looting_count.description: Each level of Looting adds 0 to this many more of the item (vanilla's 0 to 1 for most drops).
looting_count.title: Looting Count

MobDropDef.title: MobDropDef

MobModelDef.description:
The placeholder model and texture, until A2 (RLM-48) brings the art: a build that fills the hitbox, a
surface, eyes and colours.

build.description: humanoid: legs, body and head in thirds; slim: an enderman's long legs and arms, a tall head; golem: a broad body with shells on its front and back, long thick arms and a big head.
build.title: Build

eyes.description: dot: one bright pixel each; tall: two bright pixels each; gem: 2x3 white with a two-pixel pupil in the variant's accent.
eyes.title: Eyes

surface.description: speckled stone; smooth stone; mossy bricks with moss hanging off and gems in holes (the variant's accent).
surface.title: Surface

MobModelDef.title: MobModelDef

MobSizeDef.description: The mob's hitbox in blocks; the placeholder model fills it.
MobSizeDef.title: MobSizeDef

MobSoundsDef.description:
The sounds it makes, by sound event id (ours from content/sounds/, or vanilla's); a sound left out is
vanilla's for hostile mobs (none for ambient, and the step sound of the block it walks on).

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

ambient.description: Now and then while it lives.
ambient.title: Ambient

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.
Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.
Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

step.description: Each step it takes; silent: it walks without a sound.
step.title: Step

MobSoundsDef.title: MobSoundsDef

MobVariantDef.description:
One kind of the mob, rolled when it spawns and kept for its life: its own accent colour in its placeholder
texture (eyes, gems), and drops on top of the mob's own.

accent.description: Its colour in the placeholder texture: pupils and gems, "#RRGGBB".
accent.title: Accent

loot.description: What this variant drops besides the mob's own.
loot.title: Loot

weight.description: How likely it is against the other variants.
weight.title: Weight

MobVariantDef.title: MobVariantDef

description:
A custom mob, ``realmforge:<id>``: an entity type of one archetype with its data. Its name is the entity
type's translation, ``entity.realmforge.<id>``, shown in Neat's card, Jade's tooltip and death messages.

archetype.description: melee: walks up to its target and hits it; caster: casts its spells from a distance.
archetype.title: Archetype

caster.description: A caster's spells and steps; only for archetype caster.

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

death_particles.description: A block, e.g. realmforge:vaultstone: the mob breaks apart into its particles when it dies, as a mined block does, and its body is gone at once.
death_particles.title: Death Particles

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

idle.description: stroll: wanders while it has no target; guard: stands at the spot where it spawned and walks back to it once it loses its target.
idle.title: Idle

loot.description: What it may drop when it dies.
loot.title: Loot

melee.description: How a melee mob hits; only for archetype melee.

name.description: The mob's name, Title Case (lore style guide).

tags.description: Our entity type tags it belongs to, e.g. realmforge:stone_creatures, which a spell's projectile may spare.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

tags.title: Tags

variants.description: Its kinds, one rolled at spawn; none: a single kind.
variants.title: Variants
